title: pseudognaphalium obtusifolium subsp. saxicola
intro: Pseudognaphalium obtusifolium subsp. saxicola, commonly known as Sand-leaf or Saxatile, is a subspecies of the Pseudognaphalium obtusifolium plant, which is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Pseudognaphalium obtusifolium subsp. saxicola include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
